from pypiserver.bottle_wrapper import run as bottle_run
import pathlib
import sys

cfg = RunConfig(
    port=8080,
    host='0.0.0.0',
    authenticate=(),
    password_file=None,
    disable_fallback=True,
    fallback_url=None,
    health_endpoint=None,
    server_method='auto',
    overwrite=False,
    welcome_msg=None,
    cache_control=None,
    log_req_frmt=None,

    log_err_frmt=None,
    server_base_url=None,
    roots=[pathlib.Path('packages').resolve()],
    verbosity=0,
    log_frmt=None,
    log_file=None,
    log_stream=None,
    hash_algo=None,
    backend_arg='simple-dir',
)

print('Starting server on port 8080...', file=sys.stderr)
bottle_run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=8080, server='auto')
